summary: Answered all five open owner notes (four on geography, one on tech), made Paisa Panchayat's own-tune sound note the default as the owner asked on 19 Nov, started weekly-loop cycle 2 (the promise beat stays in the hook's place) and fixed the flat kit's long hair covering faces. Redoes last night's blocked branch.
why: Owner notes come first and the owner said on 19 Nov his feedback goes straight away; no Shorts challenger had run since cycle 1 closed on 19 Nov; the auditor's tally names the promise beat the worst picture (-22.2 points in 10 of 11 Shorts).

findings.title: Paisa Panchayat: stayed to watch 37.9% (14 days), down from 44.4%
findings.detail: Cycle 1 (real photo in the hook) measured off 38.0% vs on 35.8% (5 vs 9 Shorts) before the owner adopted it. Last week's Shorts: median 400 views in 48 h, 94% viewed, 30.8 s average view (n 6). Long tests quiet-bed 1 of 4 and chart-gap-fill 2 of 4 a side: waiting.

findings.title: Directed beats had no automatic sounds
findings.detail: Since 13 Nov every beat is directed, and only build and board beats got automatic cues, so a Short's only effects were the few its script named; this is what the geography owner heard.

findings.title: Flat kit bug: long hair drawn over the face
findings.detail: remotion/src/flat/cast.tsx drew the long-hair panel after the face (QA overlap notes on 20 videos in 14 days); no published video uses it.

findings.title: Other channels
findings.detail: Geography 2 Shorts with 48 h data, tech 1, the rest 0: no experiments; their own loops wait for data.

changes.title: Own tune in every new Paisa Panchayat Short
